precedence.base: Current house-contrast sharedLighting inherited exactly; Bible defines realism. Weather/time endpoint overrides only specified fields. No duplicate EV, wet darkening, AO or fog.

sky.interpolation: Linear RGB; elevation above world horizon, not screen height

sun.fixturePolicy: One illustrative art-review fixture in world coordinates. No timestamp/location or camera headings have been validated from images. Production live/recap solar model overrides fixture elevation/azimuth; never falsify real weather/time to enforce hero lighting.
sun.fillCalibration: On the same neutral diagnostic plane, normalized lit contributions are direct=.38 and diffuse fill=.62, giving shadow/lit=.62 before AO. These are contribution ratios, not renderer-specific environment intensity units. Calibrate against E0; directIntensityRelativeClearE0=1 retains the clear-state sun scale.

shadows.tintRole: Cool-neutral gray-blue appearance cue, not a purple overlay on every surface or a replacement albedo
shadows.softEdgePolicy: Existing filtered directional shadows with moderate penumbra; preserve dark geometric recesses. No additional shadow map/light/pass.
shadows.occlusionMerge: min(existingVisibility,newVisibility); don't multiply repeated contact AO

exposure.reference: Frozen clear-day E0 from existing paintover-v1 ordinary-street, not absolute camera EV/lux
exposure.toneMapPolicy: Use one renderer tone mapper/white balance across views. Warm sun is lighting; no extra yellow/sepia post-grade.

ground.colorRole: Dry neutral reference/base swatches, not fixed lit/shadow pixels

trees.positionPolicy: Keep existing trunk bases and approximate crown envelopes

dressing.placement: Illustrative inferred curbside dressing; road-side of curb only, clear sidewalks and drive accesses

dressing.treePits: Small earth/mulch pits at existing parkway trunks only; not authorization to move trees or pave lawns

materialFormula.base: Cdry_linear * (1-darkeningPercent/100); interpolate rows in linear light
materialFormula.sheen: Csheen=(1-k)*Cwet + k*Csky_reflected; k=sheenStrength*pow(1-abs(dot(N,V)),3)*exposureMask; use this synthetic branch OR calibrated sky BRDF, never both.
materialFormula.eligibility: Mapped surface type wins; shelter/upward-normal masks gate wetness; no glossy whole lawn or puddles on sloped roofs.
materialFormula.drying: Drying row is a preview endpoint, not a fixed time after rain. Surface wetness follows weather-v1 reservoir/history. Mask shape stable through state changes.

puddles.eligibility: Known low areas/drainage override; otherwise tagged demo/inferred gutter or pavement depressions only. No flooding/ponding observation inferred from rain.
puddles.mask: Stable two-band field 0.4-1.2m / 2-5m, clipped to eligible polygons. Increase threshold to shrink connected pools while drying. No per-frame random reseed.
puddles.formula: Cpool=(1-k)*Cwet+k*Csky(reflect(-V,N)); k=.12+(.55-.12)*pow(1-abs(dot(N,V)),5). Synthetic opacity is material mixing, not alpha transparency. Exposure/shelter mask scales k. Use time-correct sky.
puddles.contrastScope: Readability goal relative to adjacent shaded wet pavement in neutral-overcast phone fixture; not enforced energy gain or universal physical rule.
puddles.nightContrastPolicy: No daytime luminance floor. Use current sky/lamp field; reflections may be darker than nearby light pavement.

ripples.representation: Bounded analytic ring modulation of reflection/normal inside same puddle shader; no collision solve, no geometry rings. Fade unresolved rings rather than widen.

rain.colorSource: Current sky/fog neutral cool tone, bounded local light response. Do not use unlit fixed-white snow streaks.
rain.countScope: CPU seeded particle pool count is not on-screen count; validate projected visibility and alpha area at actual camera.
rain.shelter: Supplied roof/shelter mask hides precipitation under cover; depth test streaks.

splashes.representation: Seeded known exposed hard-surface anchors; two analytic arcs per impact, shared ring mask/instancing; no per-particle collisions.

snow.coverMeaning: Opaque eligible area fraction, not opacity; accumulation independent of current snowfall. State examples are explicit controlled demos.

banks.sourceRequired: Explicit clearing/plowing history or labeled demo override; never snowfall code alone.
banks.geometry: Opaque simple ridges clipped beside cleared corridor, keep crossings/ramps/access width clear.
banks.aerial: Merge visible bank segments into broad curb-side shapes, do not preserve lump microdetail.

performance.allocationNote: Suballocations sum to existing .35 wet and .20 particle buckets; snow masks share existing .25 pattern bucket, banks/caps share .35 geometry bucket. Targets unmeasured, never spend headroom by default.

proceduralMaskAlternative.source: Generated or authored abstract masks, no photographic albedo
proceduralMaskAlternative.filter: mips, world-space stable mapping; analytic fallback allowed

degradeOrder: halve precipitation count and alpha coverage
reduce other optional near geometry per v2 policy
performance.test: Physical iPhone 13 class, iOS26+, 10min steady and transition, fixed drawable dimensions, max/p95GPU plus thermal/frame stalls. No budget pass from artwork or RAF.

time.note: Resolveactualsunmodel/timezone; offsetdoesnotguarantee a fixedtwilightcategory. Thisimage is authoredbluehourtarget.
Fullnightfixture; mooncontribution onlyifcomputedabovehorizon. No moon insertedintheseimages.
Authoreddemo; actualmodelgoverns sun/shadows. Sourcecameras retained, sun-facing side inart illustrative, not ephemerisverified.

groundFog.liftRule: Onlydemoauto-lifts. Live requires refreshedweather/layerdata; sunlight alone not sufficient. Dampnessdecays independently.

streetlights.cctNote: Illustrativeidentity only, hexes artistic swatches not colorimetricCCTconversion; sodium not chosenfromwarmcolouralone.
streetlights.poolFormula: Add maxRadiance*exp(-ln2*(r/rHalf)^2)*smoothTaper(r,0.8*rSupport,rSupport)*normalEligibility*occlusionEligibility; clampcombinedNoonRelative.30. Fixtureorientation may stretchroadellipse1.5x, supportdimensionsscaledexplicitly.
streetlights.inventory: Useactualfixturedata/sceneobjects. Demo-addedfixtures inart are conceptproposals, not verifiedlocations. Never infer roadlight everytree or newprivateporchfixture.

windows.selection: Seedstableworld/building/apertureids. RankeligibleexistingapertureswithdeterministicstablePRNG; selectround(p*N)inloadedstabletile. Groupfloors/households forplausiblevariation; no per-frame random. Persistselection acrosscameras/time states; statefactor changesintensity/thresholdbyfixedseed.
windows.geometry: Emissiveexistingwindowfaces, preserveframes/openings. No newwindowcuts, roomprops, people, silhouettedplants or lightbehindopaque wall.
windows.scope: Shares referwindowapertures, notbuildings. Extendsweather-v1stable20–30%policytoauthored20–40%windowrange peruserrequest; do notsilentlyconflate.

fog.formula: tau=integral(sigmaHaze+sigmaGround*wHeight*wPatch)ds; Cout=exp(-tau)*Clit+(1-exp(-tau))*CfogEffective. One fog application. Effectivefogcolour opticaldepthweightedbetweenhaze/ground; no duplicatefogpass.
fog.height: w=1 belowH-taper, linearfalloff to0 atH, zeroabovelayer; terrain/lakereference elevation supplied.
fog.patch: Stablebroadworld-spacepatches only. Max4 precomputedcenters/scales, edges8–12m. No particles/cloudcards/fastnoise. Cliptoactualpark/water eligibility; datarequired. Roadfog mayextendnearby but cannotchangegeometry.
fog.evaluation: Flat uniformheightlayer permitsclosed-formintegral. Patchmode mayusebounded4-samplequadrature overraysegmentinside2.5m layer; unmeasuredmaterialcost. No arbitraryscreenoverlays, no volumetricraymarch solver.
fog.baselineFallback: Ifpatch/layerdata unsupported usehomogeneoussigma flagassumption; cannotclaimpatchparity. Haze stillmatches water/land/backdrop.

performance.test: 10min physicalphone fixeddrawable resolution night/fog/lift, max+p95GPU/thermal/roadmask/occlusion checks; artnotdevicepass.

water.wavePolicy: Amplitude is half peak-to-trough height. Profiles are look fixtures, not wave forecasts. Actual wind direction, duration, fetch, depth and observed waves override. Wind0 fixture has no leftover swell; live state can retain swell history.

shoreline.application: Water-side band only. Smoothstep from shore inward: shade multiplier=0.88+0.12*smoothstep(0,0.60,distanceToShore). Independent shore geometry remains fixed. Shallow-colour weight=1-smoothstep(0,shallowBlendWidthM,distanceToShore). No extra land darkening.
shoreline.edge: Separate 0.40m material transition into existing wet bank, clipped to mapped terrain intersection. No black border, alpha water overlay or shoreline relocation.

reflection.policy: These stylized blend coefficients are not measured Fresnel. No white brightness floor at night. Reuse sky environment; no planar mirrors, SSR, extra captures or per-ripple lights.

haze.policy: One shared weather haze term. Longer sight lines get more haze naturally; no separate lake fog multiplier. Live fog overrides fixture.

lod.farPolicy: Fade subpixel normals, retain mean roughness and broad reflected sky. Never enlarge world-space wavelengths to force visibility. Wind0 means no wave oscillation.

ice.policy: Coverage fixtures depict Sloan city lake only. Never apply fully_frozen fixture to all Lake Michigan from air temperature. Freeze disables waves only inside ice mask; open water remains animated. No crack/photo texture. Snow coverage denominator is ice area, not full lake area.

branchSnow.eligibleSurface: Upward-facing structural branch/crown tops; normal dot up >=0.35. Denominator is this eligible area, not whole tree silhouette.
branchSnow.policy: Fresh and day2 are seeded comparison fixtures. Clock age alone never sheds snow. Wind exposure, melt, canopy type and new snowfall update area mask. Merge structural snow strips at range; no leaf/needle/twig geometry.

oldSnow.persistence: When supplied snow depth outside the 0.80m curb zone falls below0.01m, retain only supplied remaining bank/slush inside eligible curb zone until reservoir is zero. Distance is maximum support strip, not duration. Do not invent snow along every curb.
oldSnow.policy: Traffic/plow contamination affects pile base, not clean lawn uniformly. Snow depth, thaw/solar exposure and reservoir govern melt; days only select artwork fixtures. Existing clear corridors, crossings and ramps clip banks and slush.

water: Wind speed and direction history for last3hours
Fetch/depth/shore geometry or explicit look fixture; observed waves if available
ice: Observed or supplied ice concentration/geometry and lake surface water temperature
Air temperature time series and cumulative freezing degree-hours (sum(max(0,-TairC)*hours)) as context
Wind/mixing, bathymetry and multi-day water thermal history; no universal cold-hour threshold
branchSnow: Snowfall water equivalent and event end time
Retained crown snow load and canopy type
Wind exposure/gust history, positive-degree-hours, solar exposure and new snowfall
oldSnow: Days since snowfall, cumulative positive-degree-hours and rain-on-snow
Explicit clearing/plowing timestamps, retained displaced-bank volume and curb drainage
weatherHistory.missingHistory: Unknown stays unknown. Preserve last supplied state if valid; otherwise do not infer ice/banks/snow from season or present weather code. Explicit demo fixtures are labelled.

sources.role: Point discovery, hourly/grid forecasts, station observations and alerts. Radar status endpoint is NOT radar imagery. Forecast and observation fields must stay distinct.

MRMS precipitation-rate, type and hail products where supplied; resolve product catalogue, timestamps, projection and units in adapter. QPE is estimated precipitation, not street-scale observed wetness.
National Snow Analyses snow depth and accumulation context; combine local snowfall, temperature, wind and prior reservoir. No branch snow or plowing inference from coarse grid alone.
METAR visibility, present weather, wind, cloud layers and dew point; station observation is not every neighbourhood, hillside or fog-bank outline.

GOES regional cloud pattern context; derive simplified cloud coverage/bands in a server adapter. Never drape satellite photographs onto world surfaces. Cloud-base fog confirmation needs visibility/low-cloud observations.
Tropical advisory track/extent context only; not a source of exact visible street-level cloud bands or wind damage.
Location, timestamp, timezone and computed sun elevation/azimuth; solar geometry drives sunset, blue hour, rainbow alignment and night. No fake lighting time to obtain a hero.
Regional species/calendar and supplied seasonal history for autumn and leaf-out. Weather API alone cannot prove peak foliage colour at a street.

regions.name: Chicago
rows: Lake-effect snow squall: left cold overcast clear-air lakeshore path with brick housing; right same geometry during a dense wind-driven snow curtain, thin fresh snow on exposed tops, Lake Michigan remains open.

Summer thunderstorm over Lake Michigan: left humid bright lakefront skyline and park before storm; right identical viewpoint with a huge softly modeled dark cloud shelf and distant rain over water, foreground slightly damp.

Loop at blue hour: left Loop elevated rail corridor in ordinary late afternoon; right identical geometry at blue hour with cool readable building fill, sparse warm windows and small grounded warm streetlight pools, dry pavement.

regions.name: Denver / Front Range
rows: Spring snow on green trees: left Sloan's Lake residential edge in early spring with newly green deciduous crowns; right same camera with wet spring snow resting on upper green branches and lawns, moderate falling flakes, clear sidewalk gaps.

Mountain sunset alpenglow: left west-facing Front Range foothill neighbourhood in neutral late-afternoon daylight; right same camera, mountain summits glow restrained coral gold with cool shaded lower slopes and houses, soft warm horizon, no orange global wash.

Afternoon hail-storm sky: left Denver neighbourhood with distant Front Range in blue midafternoon; right same camera dark towering thunderhead and localized pale hail/rain shaft approaching beyond houses, subdued gray-green underside, tiny sparse hail cues only no damage.

regions.name: Miami
rows: Tropical downpour then rainbow: left Miami Beach pastel low-rise neighbourhood and palms during heavy tropical rain, wet road with bounded broken reflections; right same camera after rain with sun breaking through and a subtle geometrically plausible rainbow over residual distant rain, still-wet road.

Hurricane-season cloud band, no damage: left Miami coastal street and ocean glimpse in humid partly cloudy daylight; right same camera with broad curved layered tropical cloud bands and distant rain curtains, palms lightly wind-bent, no flood, debris or damage.

Neon-warm Ocean Drive night: left unbranded Art Deco facade rhythm with palms in neutral daytime; right identical scene at night with localized warm amber and soft coral/turquoise architectural glow from plain light strips, cool readable sky/ambient, absolutely no signs or lettering.

regions.name: San Francisco
rows: Fog rolling over hills and bridge silhouette: left SF residential hillside with plausible Golden Gate silhouette beyond bay, clear marine morning; right same geometry with broad low marine fog rolling around hills and partly obscuring bridge, near houses readable.

Golden hour through fog: left same hill/bay/bridge setting under cool marine fog; right exact composition with low sun warming upper fog layer pale gold, bridge emerges softly, no dramatic god rays or orange filter.

regions.name: Seattle
rows: Drizzle and mist on conifers: left Seattle residential street with tall real-scale conifers and neutral overcast light; right identical scene with fine drizzle, damp restrained roadway, depth-correct mist softening far crowns.

Rare clear day with mountain backdrop: left south-facing Seattle hillside residential viewpoint with cloud obscuring distant Mount Rainier; right same geometry on a clean clear day revealing correctly proportioned distant glaciated mountain, fresh neutral-blue sky and restrained sun.

regions.name: Phoenix
rows: Monsoon storm and dust wall approaching: left Phoenix desert-edge neighbourhood with saguaro, palo verde and distant ridges in hot clear light; right same camera with dark monsoon tower and broad tan dust wall approaching in far background, clear foreground and intact buildings, no theatrical cyclone.

Desert night with city glow: left west-facing desert-edge neighbourhood and distant Phoenix skyline in late afternoon; right identical geometry at desert night, cool readable desert, warm low horizon city glow and sparse stars, no giant moon or Milky Way.

regions.name: New England
rows: Peak autumn colour after rain: left New England village street with white clapboard houses, real-scale maples in peak muted red/gold/ochre foliage during soft rain; right identical composition after rain with restrained low sun, moist dark road and tiny broken puddle highlights, believable bark/crowns without individual leaf noise.

regions.name: Gulf Coast
rows: Humid sunset with towering cumulus: left Gulf Coast coastal neighbourhood and marsh-water glimpse under humid ordinary late-afternoon light and tall softly modeled cumulus; right same composition at sunset with peach-gold cloud tops, blue-gray cloud bases and luminous humid horizon, clean intact houses.

liveStatePolicy.observationVsForecast: preserve each source timestamp, issuedAt, validAt, location, spatial resolution, QC, units and mode observed/forecast/history/demo
liveStatePolicy.freshnessPolicy: adapter respects product cadence/expiry; authored fallback if missing/stale, never call it live
liveStatePolicy.conflictPolicy: co-located fresh station observation for local visibility; radar for area precipitation estimates; forecast for future states only
liveStatePolicy.stormPlacement: radar/cloud regional extent projects to world bearings; exact visible cloud shape is stylized inference
liveStatePolicy.snowPolicy: history controls accumulation; never auto-ice Lake Michigan or spring green trees from a weather code
liveStatePolicy.fogPolicy: station visibility constrains extinction; marine fog extent/layer remains inferred unless regional observations supplied
liveStatePolicy.hailPolicy: alert/hail product is a probability/context cue, not evidence of hail at every street
liveStatePolicy.foliagePolicy: species and season/history, not direct weather API colour
liveStatePolicy.warningPolicy: no damage depiction; no event severity claim from hero art

review.sameCamera: within-row approximate visual matching; not pixel-exact render matrices
